Architecture contract:
1. New independent owned SQLite card ledger (explicit initialize, exact owned schema/application_id/version/capacity, DELETE/FULL, reject foreign/future/unknown schema or triggers without modifying it). Stable card-v1 delivery identity deterministically binds requester namespace/platform/actor, original job/revision/outbox, installed tenant/installation/app/bot/generation, private destination, render version, immutable full preview/source/coverage/link fingerprint. Hash means integrity only, current authorization still mandatory. Original record stores exact first-card JSON/wire digest AND original uncertainty before send; re-prepare same logical original must return SAME bytes/tokens/expiry, never mint fresh buttons or reset started/unknown. Changes conflict rather than overwrite. Bounded capacity, per-row body/page/token/receipt limits, global durable time highwater; expired outbox must never be deleted/reopened to resend. TTL cleanup only safe for navigation records with permanent send tombstones. Counters/SQLite integers strict; scalar booleans/malformed IDs rejected. Requester-scoped status hides body/tokens/credential/receipt.
2. Bootstrap binding: no message ID exists before send. Initial navigation capabilities are persisted INERT with the frozen initial card/outbox and original request/binding, expiry <=300s. They cannot be consumed until a direct correlated identity-checked create acknowledgement is durably recorded on the SAME owned send claim, which binds original actual message_id and activates only its tokens. Never adopt an ID supplied by a callback/user/model, or by searching text. Callback arriving before ACK commit safely fails without spending. Full lost response/no ID -> unknown, no automatic resend, no activation or recovery by callback assertion. ACK transaction failure must never activate tokens separately. No cross-database atomicity fiction: card outbox, create receipt and new navigation capabilities live in one owned ledger.
3. Claim-before-IO: atomic pending->started with random owner/token; immutable initial send_unverified marker. At most one send per logical card/revision. Losing claimant or lost begin COMMIT response cannot diagnose/change winner (U01 regression). First failure immutable, retry cannot replace it. Error/timeout/restart/cancel after started -> unknown or durable started; never reopens pending. Receipt/unknown write require returned owner+token. Timeouts finite total monotonic deadline <=30sec, UTC rollback refused, bounded async DB lock waits; timeout/cancel/stop abandon hostile awaitables without freeing active capacity until they actually exit; late results cannot persist/activate. No hidden/detached send/retry. Single owned event-loop service, explicit lifetime stop, no per-call fresh service to bypass bound. At each actual egress: durable claim/outbox-cancel check then trusted local source/grant/private mapping/revision/binding authorization after all waits. Preserve exception privacy with fixed errors, no raw cause/context/provider bodies. Cancellation must be persisted and observed across instances before IO and activation; generation/source cancellation also checked by trusted current mirror. All SQLite work before final auth at commit; then only local clock/stop + commit. Current authority failures never reopen send.
4. PrivatePreview only from original trusted stored revision via loader; explicit trusted bounded local load, authorize and binding/credential mirrors mandatory. authorize checks every source/grant snapshot, current original revision/destination and generation; no network under lock/non-reentrant code. Freeze full content/source/link fingerprint, verify current preview unchanged even if buggy loader reuses same revision ID. SourceLink must remain mapped to frozen sources. Render stored original full draft; navigation cannot switch jobs or select arbitrary model content. Keep all coverage gaps across pages and notice each page. Add bounded navigation controls with opaque callback_id ONLY, no private JSON in value; card <=16KiB including buttons. Respect previous longest-ID/page bound fail-closed behaviour. No model-generated URLs except trusted SourceLinks. Repr/status/errors must hide card/tokens.

Each page has a monotonic epoch/generation so simultaneous different buttons on one displayed card cannot both advance or create conflicting current tokens. Claim/consume old epoch + persist new epoch/tokens + exact response card atomically. Old buttons cannot revive after reload/restart; no decrement/rollback or expiry renewal from repeated preparation. Repeated callbacks do not release private content again, return generic status. Wrong identity/group/message/tenant/app/rotation/revision/purpose/digest does not burn rightful token; final auth/expiry after DB waits AND after render before private response release. If final release fails after consumption, stay spent, conservative liveness. Bounded maximum epoch/rows; pruning cannot reactivate old capability. Expired tokens require an explicit fresh authorized preview flow, no automatic resend. Signed callback responses only prepare a replacement card; HTTP response loss/client update/reordering is not confirmed by local commit. Never claim client received updated card. Provide test/documented behaviour of lost callback response (can remain unresponsive, no hidden resend).
